title.narrative: Support for Regional Technical Assistance Facility

description.narrative:
This Project aims at establishing a Technical Assistance Facility, providing logistical and technical assistance to the governments of six Central African partner countries (Cameroon, the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon and the Republic of Congo) which are part of the Central African Forest Initiative (CAFI) and receive funding from the CAFI Multi Partner Trust Fund.
The expected outcomes of the project:
Countries are supported to accelerate milestone implementation and receive assistance in their further engagement with CAFI
Selected national entities have increased ownership of CAFI programming and have direct access to the Trust Fund
Improved collaboration and communication through lessons learned and lesson sharing at the national and regional level 
 To reach the set outcomes, UNOPS will provide logistical support through the purchase of equipment/materials, provide technical assistance through the delivery of advisory services and capacity building in areas like environment, biodiversity, forestry, agriculture, IT, HR, law among others , and support national capacity in the organization of events such as conferences, workshops, high level meetings. These activities will be conducted upon prior approval from CAFI and availability of funds.
